items.question: How is a single syllable established as twelvefold through division by measures?
premises: A single syllable is the subject under consideration.
That syllable is described as divided or cut by measures.
The resulting state of that syllable is described as twelvefold.
items.inference: One syllable becomes established in twelve forms when differentiated by measures.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of mātrā in this ritual-phonetic context is not fully specified in the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Or indeed, a single syllable, divided—or cut—by measures, is established as twelvefold.
